name: IntuneGraph
description: IntuneGraph turns your Microsoft Intune tenant into an interactive relationship graph. It provides a read-only, offline snapshot showing what applies to a device and why, and lets you preview the impact of membership changes before you touch a group. By surfacing nesting, filters, and include/exclude paths, it helps identify orphaned, broken, or misconfigured targets and assess assignment hygiene.
author: Juan Andres Rodriguez

securityCheck.aiSummary: The code does not appear to download/run remote scripts or contain hardcoded secrets, but there is a potential data exposure risk via the HTML report containing the full graph payload. Address by redacting sensitive fields or offering sanitized/export-safe report options.
